instruction: You have trouble remembering short waiting periods. Open the caregiver note on the Desktop, then use https://vclock.com to create and start a timer for the eye-drop waiting interval in the note. Leave the timer running and visible in the browser.
source: Local caregiver note prepared for the task
gt_steps: Read that the next eye drop should be given after 5 minutes.
Create and start a 5 minute timer.
Leave the timer running and visible in the browser.

parameters.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Desktop\caregiver_note.txt') -Value 'Caregiver note: Please give the next eye drop after 5 minutes.'"
